jsonLd.name: Botox for Bruxism (Masseter) in Miami
jsonLd.description: Botulinum toxin in the masseter muscle to treat bruxism and slim the jawline, in Miami at Real Aesthetic. Supervised by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C.

mainEntity.name: How long until I see relief from jaw clenching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients begin to feel less jaw tension within 5 to 10 days and full effect at around 2 weeks. Visible slimming of the masseter, when that is part of the goal, develops gradually over 4 to 6 weeks as the muscle reduces in volume. Each subsequent session can reinforce the result.

mainEntity.name: Will I still be able to chew normally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The goal of the dose is to relax the muscle, not to paralyse it. You retain full normal chewing function. The first 1 to 2 weeks may feel slightly different as you adapt, especially with harder foods, but normal eating is preserved throughout the treatment cycle.

mainEntity.name: How often do I need to repeat the treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The effect lasts approximately 3 to 4 months for relaxation and longer for visible masseter slimming. Patients usually book follow-up sessions every 3 to 4 months at the beginning, then can space them further apart once the muscle has reduced. Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C will design your cadence.

hero.title: Botox for Bruxism in Miami
hero.lede: Targeted neuromodulator injection in the masseter muscle relaxes jaw clenching, relieves bruxism-related tension, and softens a square jawline in patients with masseter hypertrophy.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Reduces involuntary jaw clenching and night-time teeth grinding (bruxism).
Eases tension headaches and TMJ-related discomfort linked to masseter overuse.
Slims a visibly square or wide jawline through progressive masseter reduction.
Effect typically begins within 5–10 days and lasts 3–4 months.
Performed in a single in-office session of approximately 20 minutes.
Conservative dosing — designed to relax, not to weaken essential chewing function.
